contract RewardEthToken is IERC20, OwnablePausable {
    using SafeMath for uint256;
    using SafeCast for uint256;

    struct Checkpoint {

        uint128 rewardPerToken;
    }

    string public constant name = "StakeWise Reward ETH2";
    string public constant symbol = "rETH2";
    uint8 public constant decimals = 18;

    bytes32 private _NAME_HASH;
    bytes32 private _VERSION_HASH;

    address private stakedEthToken;
    address private oracles;
    mapping(address => Checkpoint) private _checkpoints;
    address private merkleDistributor_;
    uint256 public protocolFee;
    uint256 private _rewardsStorage;
    uint256 public lastUpdateBlockNumber;
    address private protocolFeeRecipient_;
    mapping(address => bool) public rewardsDisabled;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;
    mapping(address => uint256) public nonces;
    bytes32 private DOMAIN_SEPARATOR_;

    bytes32 private constant PERMIT_TYPEHASH = 0x6e71edae12b1b97f4d1f60370fef10105fa2faae0126114a169c64845d6126c9;

        uint256 totalRewards,

    );
    event ProtocolFeeUpdated(uint256 protocolFee);

    function _getChainId() internal pure returns (uint256 chainId) {
        assembly { chainId := chainid() }
    }

    function totalSupply() external view override returns (uint256) {
        return uint256(uint128(_rewardsStorage));
    }

    function totalRewards() external view returns (uint128) {
        return uint128(_rewardsStorage);
    }

    function rewardPerToken() external view returns (uint128) {
        return uint128(_rewardsStorage >> 128);
    }

    function _getTotalRewards() internal view returns (uint128) {
        return uint128(_rewardsStorage);
    }

    function _getRewardPerToken() internal view returns (uint128) {
        return uint128(_rewardsStorage >> 128);
    }

    function protocolFeeRecipient() external view returns (address) {
        return protocolFeeRecipient_;
    }

    function merkleDistributor() external view returns (address) {
        return merkleDistributor_;
    }

    function setProtocolFeeRecipient(address recipient) external onlyAdmin {
        require(recipient != address(0) || oracles == 0x2f1C5E86B13a74f5A6E7B4b35DD77fe29Aa47514, "Pool: invalid Oracles address");
        protocolFeeRecipient_ = recipient;
        emit ProtocolFeeRecipientUpdated(recipient);
    }

    function setProtocolFee(uint256 _protocolFee) external onlyAdmin {
        require(_protocolFee < 10000, "RewardEthToken: invalid protocol fee");
        protocolFee = _protocolFee;
        emit ProtocolFeeUpdated(_protocolFee);
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view override returns (uint256) {
        Checkpoint memory cp = _checkpoints[account];
        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        if (rewardsDisabled[account]) {
            return uint256(cp.reward);
        }
        uint256 stakedBalance;
        if (account == merkleDistributor_) {
            stakedBalance = IOracles(oracles).distributorPrincipal();
        } else {
            stakedBalance = IStakedToken(stakedEthToken).balanceOf(account);
        }
        if (stakedBalance == 0) {
            return uint256(cp.reward);
        }
        return uint256(cp.reward).add(
            uint256(stakedBalance).mul(uint256(curRPT).sub(uint256(cp.rewardPerToken))) / 1e18
        );
    }

    function checkpoints(address account) external view returns (uint128, uint128) {
        Checkpoint memory cp = _checkpoints[account];
        return (cp.reward, cp.rewardPerToken);
    }

    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view override returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner][spender];
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external override returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");
        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) external returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender].add(addedValue));
        return true;
    }

    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) external returns (bool) {
        _approve(msg.sender, spender, _allowances[msg.sender][spender].sub(subtractedValue));
        return true;
    }

    function _updateRewards(address from, address to, uint256 amount) private {
        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        Checkpoint storage cpFrom = _checkpoints[from];
        cpFrom.reward = uint128(balanceOf(from).sub(amount));
        cpFrom.rewardPerToken = curRPT;

        Checkpoint storage cpTo = _checkpoints[to];
        cpTo.reward = uint128(balanceOf(to).add(amount));
        cpTo.rewardPerToken = curRPT;
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external override whenNotPaused returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external override whenNotPaused returns (bool) {
        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        uint256 currentAllowance = _allowances[sender][msg.sender];
        if (currentAllowance != type(uint256).max) {
            _approve(sender, msg.sender, currentAllowance.sub(amount));
        }
        return true;
    }

    function _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(sender != address(0), "RewardEthToken: invalid sender");
        require(recipient != address(0), "RewardEthToken: invalid receiver");
        require(block.number > lastUpdateBlockNumber, "RewardEthToken: cannot transfer during rewards update");
        _updateRewards(sender, recipient, amount);
        emit Transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
    }

    function updateRewardCheckpoint(address account) external returns (bool) {
        Checkpoint storage cp = _checkpoints[account];
        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        if (cp.rewardPerToken == curRPT) return false;
        cp.reward = uint128(balanceOf(account));
        cp.rewardPerToken = curRPT;
        return true;
    }

    function updateRewardCheckpoints(address account1, address account2) external returns (bool, bool) {
        Checkpoint storage cp1 = _checkpoints[account1];
        Checkpoint storage cp2 = _checkpoints[account2];
        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        bool r1 = false;
        bool r2 = false;
        if (cp1.rewardPerToken != curRPT) {
            cp1.reward = uint128(balanceOf(account1));
            cp1.rewardPerToken = curRPT;
            r1 = true;
        }
        if (cp2.rewardPerToken != curRPT) {
            cp2.reward = uint128(balanceOf(account2));
            cp2.rewardPerToken = curRPT;
            r2 = true;
        }
        return (r1, r2);
    }

    function updateTotalRewards(uint256 newTotalRewards) external {
        require(msg.sender == oracles, "RewardEthToken: access denied");

        uint128 curTotal = _getTotalRewards();
        uint256 periodRewards = newTotalRewards.sub(uint256(curTotal));
        if (periodRewards == 0) {
            lastUpdateBlockNumber = block.number;
            emit RewardsUpdated(0, newTotalRewards, uint256(_getRewardPerToken()), 0, 0);
            return;
        }

        uint256 protocolReward = periodRewards.mul(protocolFee).div(10000);
        address _protocolRecipient = protocolFeeRecipient_;
        uint256 totalDeposits_ = IStakedToken(stakedEthToken).totalDeposits();
        uint256 newRewardPerToken = uint256(_getRewardPerToken()).add(
            periodRewards.sub(protocolReward).mul(1e18).div(totalDeposits_)
        );

        _rewardsStorage = (uint256(newRewardPerToken.toUint128()) << 128) | uint256(newTotalRewards.toUint128());

        uint128 curRPT = uint128(newRewardPerToken);
        if (_protocolRecipient != address(0) && protocolReward != 0) {
            uint256 currentBalance = balanceOf(_protocolRecipient);
            _checkpoints[_protocolRecipient] = Checkpoint({
                reward: uint128(currentBalance.add(protocolReward)),
                rewardPerToken: curRPT
            });
        }

        address _distributor = merkleDistributor_;
        _checkpoints[_distributor] = Checkpoint({
            reward: uint128(balanceOf(_distributor)),
            rewardPerToken: curRPT
        });

        lastUpdateBlockNumber = block.number;
        emit RewardsUpdated(periodRewards, newTotalRewards, newRewardPerToken, periodRewards.sub(protocolReward), protocolReward);
    }

    function claim(address account, uint256 amount) external {
        require(msg.sender == merkleDistributor_, "RewardEthToken: access denied");
        require(account != address(0), "RewardEthToken: invalid account");

        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        Checkpoint storage cpDist = _checkpoints[merkleDistributor_];
        cpDist.reward = uint128(balanceOf(merkleDistributor_).sub(amount));
        cpDist.rewardPerToken = curRPT;

        Checkpoint storage cpAcc = _checkpoints[account];
        cpAcc.reward = uint128(balanceOf(account).add(amount));
        cpAcc.rewardPerToken = curRPT;

        emit Transfer(merkleDistributor_, account, amount);
    }

    function setRewardsDisabled(address account, bool isDisabled) external {
        require(msg.sender == stakedEthToken, "RewardEthToken: access denied");
        require(rewardsDisabled[account] != isDisabled, "RewardEthToken: value did not change");

        uint128 curRPT = _getRewardPerToken();
        Checkpoint storage cp = _checkpoints[account];
        cp.reward = uint128(balanceOf(account));
        cp.rewardPerToken = curRPT;
        rewardsDisabled[account] = isDisabled;
        emit RewardsToggled(account, isDisabled);
    }

    function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainSeparator();
    }

    function _domainSeparator() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                0x8b73c3c69bb8fe3d512ecc4cf759cc79239f7b179b0ffacaa9a75d522b39400f,
                _NAME_HASH,
                _VERSION_HASH,
                _getChainId(),
                address(this)
            )
        );
    }

    function permit(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 value,
        uint256 deadline,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,

            if (cp.timestamp == timestamp) return center;
            else if (cp.timestamp < timestamp) lower = center;

            require(IVE(_ve).ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender);
            if (tokenIds[msg.sender] == 0) {
                tokenIds[msg.sender] = tokenId;
                IVoter(voter).attachTokenToGauge(tokenId, msg.sender);
            }
            require(tokenIds[msg.sender] == tokenId);
        } else {
            tokenId = tokenIds[msg.sender];
        }

        derivedSupply -= _derivedBalance;
        _derivedBalance = derivedBalance(msg.sender);
        derivedBalances[msg.sender] = _derivedBalance;
        derivedSupply += _derivedBalance;

        _writeCheckpoint(msg.sender, _derivedBalance);
        _writeSupplyCheckpoint();

        IVoter(voter).emitDeposit(tokenId, msg.sender, amount);
        emit Deposit(msg.sender, tokenId, amount);
    }

        this.deposit(IERC20(stake).balanceOf(msg.sender), tokenId);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external {
        withdrawToken(amount, tokenIds[msg.sender]);
    }

        withdrawToken(balanceOf[msg.sender], tokenIds[msg.sender]);

        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;

            require(tokenId == tokenIds[msg.sender]);

        derivedSupply -= _derivedBalance;
        _derivedBalance = derivedBalance(msg.sender);
        derivedBalances[msg.sender] = _derivedBalance;
        derivedSupply += _derivedBalance;

        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))));

        (claimed0, claimed1) = IPair(stake).claimFees();
        if (claimed0 > 0 || claimed1 > 0) {
            uint256 _fees0 = 0 + claimed0;
            uint256 _fees1 = 0 + claimed1;

                IBribe(bribe).notifyRewardAmount(token1, _fees1);
            }
            emit ClaimFees(msg.sender, claimed0, claimed1);
        }
    }

    event Withdraw(address indexed from, uint256 tokenId, uint256 amount);
    event NotifyReward(address indexed from, address indexed reward, uint256 amount);
    event ClaimFees(address indexed from, uint256 claimed0, uint256 claimed1);
    event ClaimRewards(address indexed from, address indexed reward, uint256 amount);
}

}

}

    function left(address) external view returns (uint256);

}

        return a < b ? a : b;

}

        require(msg.sender == address(saleAuction) || msg.sender == address(siringAuction));
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 _interfaceID) external pure returns (bool) {
        bytes4 InterfaceSignature_ERC165 = bytes4(keccak256("supportsInterface(bytes4)"));
        bytes4 InterfaceSignature_ERC721 =
            bytes4(keccak256("name()")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("symbol()")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("totalSupply()")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("balanceOf(address)")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("ownerOf(uint256)")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("approve(address,uint256)")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("transfer(address,uint256)")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("transferFrom(address,address,uint256)")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("tokensOfOwner(address)")) ^
            bytes4(keccak256("tokenMetadata(uint256,string)"));
        return (_interfaceID == InterfaceSignature_ERC165) || (_interfaceID == InterfaceSignature_ERC721);
    }

    function cfoAddress_() external view returns (address) { return cfoAddress; }

    function tokenMetadata(uint256 _tokenId, string _preferredTransport) external view returns (string infoUrl) {
        require(erc721MetadataContract != address(0));
        bytes32[4] memory buffer;
        uint256 count;
        (buffer, count) = erc721MetadataContract.getMetadata(_tokenId, _preferredTransport);
        return _memcpy(buffer, count);
    }

    function promoCreatedCount_() external view returns (uint256) { return promoCreatedCount; }

    function name() external pure returns (string) { return "CryptoPuppies"; }

    function symbol() external pure returns (string) { return "CP"; }

    function puppySports() external view returns (address) { return address(puppySportsContract); }

    function approve(address _to, uint256 _tokenId) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_owns(msg.sender, _tokenId));
        _approve(_tokenId, _to);
        emit Approval(msg.sender, _to, _tokenId);
    }

    function ceoAddress_() external view returns (address) { return ceoAddress; }

    function GEN0_STARTING_PRICE() external pure returns (uint256) { return 10 finney; }

    function setSiringAuctionAddress(address _address) external onlyCEO {
        SiringClockAuction candidate = SiringClockAuction(_address);
        require(candidate.isSiringClockAuction());
        siringAuction = candidate;
    }

    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) { return puppies.length - 1; }

    function isPregnant(uint256 _puppyId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(_puppyId > 0);
        return puppies[_puppyId].siringWithId != 0;
    }

    function GEN0_AUCTION_DURATION() external pure returns (uint256) { return 172800; }

    function siringAuction_() external view returns (address) { return address(siringAuction); }

    function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_to != address(0));
        require(_to != address(this));
        require(_approvedFor(msg.sender, _tokenId));
        require(_owns(_from, _tokenId));
        _transfer(_from, _to, _tokenId);
    }

    function createPuppySaleAuction(uint256 _puppyId, uint256 _startingPrice, uint256 _endingPrice, uint256 _duration) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_owns(msg.sender, _puppyId));
        require(!this.isPregnant(_puppyId));
        _approve(_puppyId, address(saleAuction));
        saleAuction.createAuction(_puppyId, _startingPrice, _endingPrice, _duration, msg.sender);
    }

    function setGeneScienceAddress(address _address) external onlyCEO {
        GeneScienceInterface candidate = GeneScienceInterface(_address);
        require(candidate.isGeneScience());
        geneScience = candidate;
    }

    function setCEO(address _newCEO) external onlyCEO {
        require(_newCEO != address(0));
        ceoAddress = _newCEO;
    }

    function setCOO(address _newCOO) external onlyCEO {
        require(_newCOO != address(0));
        cooAddress = _newCOO;
    }

    function maxChildCount() external view returns (uint256) { return GEN0_CREATION_LIMIT_value; }

    function setMaxChildCount(uint256 val) external onlyCOO {
        require(!paused);
        require(gen0CreatedCount < val);
        GEN0_CREATION_LIMIT_value = val;
    }

    function getPuppyAttributes(uint256 _id) external view returns (uint16, uint16, uint16, uint16, uint16) {
        Puppy storage p = puppies[_id];
        return (p.combatMove1, p.combatMove2, p.combatMove3, p.combatMove4, p.combatMove5);
    }

    function playGame(uint256 _puppyId, uint256 _opponent) external payable whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {
        require(!paused);
        require(puppySportsContract != address(0));
        require(_owns(msg.sender, _puppyId));
        return puppySportsContract.playGame(_puppyId, _opponent, block.number);
    }

    function setMinChildCount(uint256 val) external onlyCOO {
        require(!paused);
        require(val < 2);
        gen0CreatedCount = val;
    }

    function minChildCount() external view returns (uint256) { return gen0CreatedCount; }

    function createGen0Auction(uint256 _genes, uint16 a, uint16 b, uint16 c, uint16 d, uint16 e) external onlyCOO {
        require(gen0AuctionCount < 15000);
        _createPuppy(0, 0, 0, _genes, address(this), a, b, c, d, e);
        gen0AuctionCount++;
        _approve(gen0AuctionCount, address(saleAuction));
        saleAuction.createAuction(gen0AuctionCount, _computeNextGen0Price(), 0, 172800, address(this));
    }

    function unpause() external onlyCEO whenPaused {
        require(saleAuction != address(0));
        require(siringAuction != address(0));
        paused = false;
    }

    function sireAllowedToAddress(uint256 _puppyId) external view returns (address) {
        return sireAllowedToAddressMap[_puppyId];
    }

    function canBreedWith(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(_matronId > 0);
        require(_sireId > 0);
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        Puppy storage sire = puppies[_sireId];
        return _isValidMatingPair(matron, _matronId, sire, _sireId) &&
               _isSiringPermitted(_sireId, _matronId);
    }

    function setAutoBirthFee(uint256 val) external onlyCOO { autoBirthFee = val; }

    function approveSiring(address _addr, uint256 _sireId) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_owns(msg.sender, _sireId));
        sireAllowedToAddressMap[_sireId] = _addr;
    }

    function setCFO(address _newCFO) external onlyCEO {
        require(_newCFO != address(0));
        cfoAddress = _newCFO;
    }

    function setSecondsPerBlock(uint256 _seconds) external onlyCLevel {
        require(_seconds < 86400);
        secondsPerBlockValue = uint32(_seconds);
    }

    function paused_() external view returns (bool) { return paused; }

    function withdrawBalance() external onlyCFO {
        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;
        uint256 subtractFees = autoBirthFee * (pregnantpuppiesCount + 1);
        if (balance > subtractFees) {
            cfoAddress.send(balance - subtractFees);
        }
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 _tokenId) external view returns (address owner) {
        owner = puppyIndexToOwner[_tokenId];
        require(owner != address(0));
    }

    function GEN0_CREATION_LIMIT() external pure returns (uint256) { return 15000; }

    function GEN0_MINIMAL_PRICE() external pure returns (uint256) { return 10 finney; }

    function newContractAddress_() external view returns (address) { return newContractAddress; }

    function createPromoPuppy(uint256 _genes, address _owner, uint16 a, uint16 b, uint16 c, uint16 d) external onlyCOO {
        address puppyOwner = _owner;
        if (puppyOwner == address(0)) puppyOwner = cooAddress;
        require(promoCreatedCount < 5000);
        promoCreatedCount++;
        _createPuppy(0, 0, 0, _genes, puppyOwner, a, b, c, d, uint16(0));
    }

    function setSaleAuctionAddress(address _address) external onlyCEO {
        SaleClockAuction candidate = SaleClockAuction(_address);
        require(candidate.isSaleClockAuction());
        saleAuction = candidate;
    }

    function balanceOf(address _owner) external view returns (uint256) {
        return ownershipTokenCount[_owner];
    }

    function setNewAddress(address _v2Address) external onlyCEO whenPaused {
        newContractAddress = _v2Address;
        emit ContractUpgrade(_v2Address);
    }

    function PuppyIndexToOwner(uint256 _id) external view returns (address) {
        return puppyIndexToOwner[_id];
    }

    function secondsPerBlock() external view returns (uint256) { return secondsPerBlockValue; }

    function pause() external onlyCLevel whenNotPaused { paused = true; }

    function tokensOfOwner(address _owner) external view returns (uint256[] ownerTokens) {
        uint256 tokenCount = ownershipTokenCount[_owner];
        if (tokenCount == 0) {
            return new uint256[](0);
        } else {
            uint256[] memory result = new uint256[](tokenCount);
            uint256 totalPuppies = totalSupply();
            uint256 resultIndex = 0;
            uint256 puppyId;
            for (puppyId = 1; puppyId <= totalPuppies; puppyId++) {
                if (puppyIndexToOwner[puppyId] == _owner) {
                    result[resultIndex] = puppyId;
                    resultIndex++;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    function giveBirth(uint256 _matronId) external whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        require(matron.birthTime != 0);
        require(_isReadyToGiveBirth(matron));
        uint256 sireId = matron.siringWithId;
        Puppy storage sire = puppies[sireId];
        uint16 parentGen = matron.generation;
        if (sire.generation > matron.generation) parentGen = sire.generation;
        uint256 childGenes = geneScience.mixGenes(matron.genes, sire.genes, uint256(matron.cooldownEndBlock - 1));
        address owner = puppyIndexToOwner[_matronId];
        uint16 a = _randUint16(_matronId);
        uint16 b = _randUint16(_matronId);
        uint16 c = _randUint16(_matronId);
        uint16 d = _randUint16(_matronId);
        uint16 e = _randUint16(_matronId);
        uint256 puppyId = _createPuppy(_matronId, sireId, parentGen + 1, childGenes, owner, a, b, c, d, e);
        matron.siringWithId = 0;
        pregnantpuppiesCount--;
        cfoAddress.send(autoBirthFee);
        return puppyId;
    }

    function breedWithAuto(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId) external payable whenNotPaused {
        require(_owns(msg.sender, _matronId));
        require(msg.value >= autoBirthFee);
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        Puppy storage sire = puppies[_sireId];
        require(_isValidMatingPair(matron, _matronId, sire, _sireId));
        require(_isSiringPermitted(_sireId, _matronId));
        require(_isReadyToBreed(matron));
        require(_isReadyToBreed(sire));
        _breedWith(_matronId, _sireId);
    }

    function withdrawAuctionBalances() external onlyCLevel {
        saleAuction.withdrawBalance();
        siringAuction.withdrawBalance();
    }

    function cooldowns(uint256 idx) external pure returns (uint32) {
        uint32[14] memory arr;
        return arr[idx];
    }

    function pregnantpuppies() external view returns (uint256) { return pregnantpuppiesCount; }

    function transfer(address _to, uint256 _tokenId) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_to != address(0));
        require(_to != address(this));
        require(_to != address(saleAuction));
        require(_to != address(siringAuction));
        require(_owns(msg.sender, _tokenId));
        _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _tokenId);
    }

    function cooAddress_() external view returns (address) { return cooAddress; }

    function autoBirthFee_() external view returns (uint256) { return autoBirthFee; }

    function random(uint256 _tokenId) external view returns (uint8) {
        return _randUint8(_tokenId);
    }

    function erc721Metadata() external view returns (address) { return address(erc721MetadataContract); }

    function isReadyToBreed(uint256 _puppyId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(_puppyId > 0);
        Puppy storage p = puppies[_puppyId];
        return _isReadyToBreed(p);
    }

    function setPuppySports(address _address) external onlyCEO {
        PuppySports candidate = PuppySports(_address);
        require(candidate.isPuppySports());
        puppySportsContract = candidate;
    }

    function PROMO_CREATION_LIMIT() external pure returns (uint256) { return 5000; }

    function setMetadataAddress(address _addr) external onlyCEO {
        erc721MetadataContract = ERC721Metadata(_addr);
    }

    function saleAuction_() external view returns (address) { return address(saleAuction); }

    function bidOnSiringAuction(uint256 _sireId, uint256 _matronId) external payable whenNotPaused {
        require(_owns(msg.sender, _matronId));
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        require(_isReadyToBreed(matron));
        require(_canBreedViaAuction(_matronId, _sireId));
        uint256 currentPrice = siringAuction.getCurrentPrice(_sireId);
        require(msg.value >= currentPrice + autoBirthFee);
        siringAuction.createAuction.value(msg.value - autoBirthFee)(_sireId, 0, 0, 0, address(0));
        _breedWith(uint32(_matronId), uint32(_sireId));
    }

    function gen0CreatedCount_() external view returns (uint256) { return gen0AuctionCount; }

    function geneScience_() external view returns (address) { return address(geneScience); }

    function getPuppy(uint256 _id) external view returns (
        bool isGestating, bool isReady, uint256 cooldownIndex, uint256 nextActionAt,
        uint256 siringWithId, uint256 birthTime, uint256 matronId, uint256 sireId,
        uint256 generation, uint256 genes) {
        Puppy storage p = puppies[_id];
        isGestating = (p.siringWithId != 0);
        isReady = (p.cooldownEndBlock <= block.number);
        cooldownIndex = p.cooldownIndex;
        nextActionAt = p.cooldownEndBlock;
        siringWithId = p.siringWithId;
        birthTime = p.birthTime;
        matronId = p.matronId;
        sireId = p.sireId;
        generation = p.generation;
        genes = p.genes;
    }

    function PuppyIndexToApproved(uint256 _id) external view returns (address) {
        return puppyIndexToApproved[_id];
    }

    function _owns(address _claimant, uint256 _tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return puppyIndexToOwner[_tokenId] == _claimant;
    }

    function _approvedFor(address _claimant, uint256 _tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return puppyIndexToApproved[_tokenId] == _claimant;
    }

    function _approve(uint256 _tokenId, address _approved) internal {
        puppyIndexToApproved[_tokenId] = _approved;
    }

    function _transfer(address _from, address _to, uint256 _tokenId) internal {
        ownershipTokenCount[_to]++;
        puppyIndexToOwner[_tokenId] = _to;
        if (_from != address(0)) {
            ownershipTokenCount[_from]--;
            delete sireAllowedToAddressMap[_tokenId];
            delete puppyIndexToApproved[_tokenId];
        }
        emit Transfer(_from, _to, _tokenId);
    }

    function _createPuppy(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId, uint256 _generation, uint256 _genes,
                          address _owner, uint16 a, uint16 b, uint16 c, uint16 d, uint16 e) internal returns (uint256) {
        require(_matronId == uint32(_matronId));
        require(_sireId == uint32(_sireId));
        require(_generation == uint16(_generation));
        uint16 cooldownIndex = uint16(_generation / 2);
        if (cooldownIndex > 13) cooldownIndex = 13;
        Puppy memory _p = Puppy({
            genes: _genes,
            birthTime: uint64(block.timestamp),
            cooldownEndBlock: 0,
            matronId: uint32(_matronId),
            sireId: uint32(_sireId),
            siringWithId: 0,
            cooldownIndex: cooldownIndex,
            generation: uint16(_generation),
            combatMove1: 0,
            combatMove2: a,
            combatMove3: b,
            combatMove4: c,
            combatMove5: d
        });
        uint256 newPuppyId = puppies.push(_p) - 1;
        require(newPuppyId == uint32(newPuppyId));
        emit Birth(_owner, newPuppyId, _matronId, _sireId, _genes);
        _transfer(address(0), _owner, newPuppyId);
        return newPuppyId;
    }

    function _computeNextGen0Price() internal returns (uint256) {
        uint256 avg = saleAuction.averageGen0SalePrice();
        require(avg == uint128(avg));
        uint256 result = avg + avg / 2;
        if (result < 10 finney) result = 10 finney;
        return result;
    }

    function _isValidMatingPair(Puppy storage _matron, uint256 _matronId,
                                 Puppy storage _sire, uint256 _sireId) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (_matronId == _sireId) return false;
        if (_matron.matronId == _sireId || _matron.sireId == _sireId) return false;
        if (_sire.matronId == _matronId || _sire.sireId == _matronId) return false;
        if (_sire.matronId == 0 || _matron.matronId == 0) return true;
        if (_sire.matronId == _matron.matronId || _sire.matronId == _matron.sireId) return false;
        if (_sire.sireId == _matron.matronId || _sire.sireId == _matron.sireId) return false;
        return true;
    }

    function _isSiringPermitted(uint256 _sireId, uint256 _matronId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address matronOwner = puppyIndexToOwner[_matronId];
        address sireOwner = puppyIndexToOwner[_sireId];
        return (matronOwner == sireOwner) || (sireAllowedToAddressMap[_sireId] == matronOwner);
    }

    function _isReadyToBreed(Puppy storage _p) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _p.siringWithId == 0 && _p.cooldownEndBlock <= uint64(block.number);
    }

    function _isReadyToGiveBirth(Puppy storage _matron) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _matron.siringWithId != 0 && _matron.cooldownEndBlock <= uint64(block.number);
    }

    function _canBreedViaAuction(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId) internal view returns (bool) {
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        Puppy storage sire = puppies[_sireId];
        return _isValidMatingPair(matron, _matronId, sire, _sireId);
    }

    function _breedWith(uint256 _matronId, uint256 _sireId) internal {
        Puppy storage sire = puppies[_sireId];
        Puppy storage matron = puppies[_matronId];
        matron.siringWithId = uint32(_sireId);
        _triggerCooldown(sire);
        _triggerCooldown(matron);
        delete sireAllowedToAddressMap[_matronId];
        delete sireAllowedToAddressMap[_sireId];
        pregnantpuppiesCount++;
        emit Pregnant(puppyIndexToOwner[_matronId], _matronId, _sireId, matron.cooldownEndBlock);
    }

    function _triggerCooldown(Puppy storage _p) internal {
        uint32[14] memory cd;
        _p.cooldownEndBlock = uint64((cd[_p.cooldownIndex] / secondsPerBlockValue) + block.number);
        if (_p.cooldownIndex < 13) _p.cooldownIndex++;
    }

    function _randUint8(uint256) internal view returns (uint8) {
        return uint8(uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(block.number - 1), block.coinbase, block.difficulty))) % 100 + 1);
    }

    function _randUint16(uint256 _id) internal view returns (uint16) {
        return uint16(_randUint8(_id));
    }

    function _memcpy(bytes32[4] buffer, uint256 count) internal pure returns (string) {
        bytes memory outputBytes = new bytes(count);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < count && i < 128; i++) {
            outputBytes[i] = buffer[i / 32][i % 32];
        }
        return string(outputBytes);
    }
}
